title: Meromorphic sections on a locally Noetherian scheme without embedded points
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] [pqf-def-locnoeth] having no embedded points (every associated point of $\mathcal O_X$ is the generic point of an irreducible component of $X$ [def-weil-irreducible-components]), and let $X^0$ be the set of generic points [def-sc-generic-point] of the irreducible components of $X$. Write $\mathcal K_X$ for the sheaf of meromorphic functions (the sheaf associated to localizing $\mathcal O_X$ at its non-zero-divisors) and, for an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], $\mathcal K_X(\mathcal L)=\mathcal K_X\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L$. Then for $\eta\in X^0$ the stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] are $\mathcal K_{X,\eta}=\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ and $\mathcal K_X(\mathcal L)_\eta=\mathcal L_\eta$, and for every open $U\subseteq X$ the maps $$\mathcal K_X(U)\to\prod_{\eta\in X^0\cap U}\mathcal O_{X,\eta},\qquad \mathcal K_X(\mathcal L)(U)\to\prod_{\eta\in X^0\cap U}\mathcal L_\eta,$$ sending a section to its germs at the points of $X^0\cap U$, are bijective; they are compatible with restriction and with the module structure, $(ft)_\eta=f_\eta t_\eta$.
